title: Berichtigung der Landesgrenze zu Kursachsen beim graeflich v. Pueckler'schen Gut Branitz und den Doerfern Weissagk, Kreis Sorau, und Groetsch, Kreis Cottbus
bestand: Rep. 2 Kurmaerkische Kriegs- und Domaenenkammer - Akten
corroborating_file: 17B 4948 (242087), Rep. 17B Oberamtsregierung der Niederlausitz - Akten >> Verfassungs-, Gerichts- und Lehns-Sachen >> Grenz-Sachen, 1748-1751, 'Die Untersuchung der zwischen dem saechsischen Dorfe Weissagk (Kreis Sorau) und einigen brandenburgischen Doerfern streitigen Grenze', containing 'Plan der streitigen Landesgrenze zwischen Branitz und Weissagk und Groetsch und Weissagk' surveyed by Ebeling 1737, fol. 103-104
locality: Branitz / Groetsch (Kreis Cottbus) and Weissagk (Kreis Sorau), on the Cottbus-Lower Lusatia frontier
affected_extent_km: ~5-10 km of frontier around three villages
why: The only genuinely INTERNATIONAL case found: an explicit 'Berichtigung der Landesgrenze' with Electoral Saxony, worked on 1748-1751 in two independent series (Kurmaerkische Kammer forest administration and the Niederlausitz Oberamtsregierung's Grenz-Sachen), over a line already surveyed as disputed in 1737. Both files close in 1751 - the same year as the BnF represented state - so whether the sheet shows the old or the corrected line cannot be settled from the catalogue alone.
holding_institution: Brandenburgisches Landeshauptarchiv (BLHA), verified at source via Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek and the BLHA record API

title: Berichtigung der Grenze zwischen dem Amtsdorf Glauchow [Gluchow] und der schlesischen Herrschaft Sabor [Zabor]
bestand: Rep. 3 Neumaerkische Kriegs- und Domaenenkammer - Akten
classification_path: Registratur des Oberforstmeisters >> Amt Zuellichau [Sulechow] >> Forstgrenzen
counterparty: Silesia (Herrschaft Sabor) - Prussian since Breslau 1742 / Dresden 1745
locality: Glauchow [Gluchow] and Sabor [Zabor] near Zuellichau [Sulechow], Neumark-Silesia line
affected_extent_km: one Amtsdorf against one Herrschaft; forest boundary only
why: The file the brief flagged as highest priority because its Laufzeit straddles the whole source window. Reading the classification path settles it: this sits under the Chief Forest Master's registry as a FORSTGRENZE, and both parties were Prussian after 1742. It is a forest boundary between a domain village and a neighbouring lordship, not a transfer of territory between states. The Laufzeit is the span of the administrative file, not the duration of a boundary change.

title: Die Markgraefliche Kammer zu Schwedt gegen den Magistrat zu Gartz wegen streitiger Grenze zwischen Gartz und der Pommerschen Heide
corroborating_file: 37 Schwedt-Vierraden 115 (1101814, 1562-1752), 117 (1101816, 1748-1750), 118 (1101817, 1749-1775) and 119 (1101818, 1770-1789, 'Regulierung der Grenze zwischen der Herrschaft Schwedt und der Stadt Gartz')
counterparty: Prussian Pomerania (Stadt Gartz an der Oder, Prussian since the Treaty of Stockholm 1720)
locality: Gartz an der Oder / Vierraden / Pommersche Heide, on the Uckermark-Prussian Pomerania line
affected_extent_km: the heath between Gartz and Vierraden, order of 5-10 km
why: The brief filed this under the Swedish Pomerania frontier. It is not one: the parties are the Markgraefliche Kammer of Brandenburg-Schwedt and the town of Gartz, which had been PRUSSIAN since 1720, so the line audited is the Uckermark / Prussian Pomerania provincial boundary. The dispute is also demonstrably NOT settled inside the window - the same quarrel runs on through files 117, 118 and a 'Regulierung' of 1770-1789. Locally unresolved across 1751, 1756 and 1758.
holding_institution: Brandenburgisches Landeshauptarchiv (BLHA), verified at source via Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek and the BLHA record API

title: Grenzregulierungen zwischen der Feldmark Menow oder dem sogenannten Feld Lindow und dem mecklenburgischen Amt Fuerstenberg
corroborating_file: 7 Lindow/M 67 (689312), 'Grenzregulierungen im Amt Lindow und in seinen Doerfern', 1669-1758, same Bestand and classification
locality: Feldmark Menow / Feld Lindow against the Mecklenburg Amt Fuerstenberg, north of Lindow and Rheinsberg
affected_extent_km: one Feldmark against one Amt, order of 5 km
why: The brief's Lindow lead resolves into two files. 67 is the general Amt Lindow series (1669-1758); 69 is the one that actually names the counterparty, the Mecklenburg Amt Fuerstenberg, and it runs 1704-1763 - open across the whole window and beyond. An international frontier, but a single Feldmark of it.

title: Anspruch des Fuersten Sapieha zu Filehne auf ein diesseits des Grenzflusses Drage gelegenes und dem Amt Driesen gehoerendes Bruchgebiet
bestand: Rep. 3 Neumaerkische Kriegs- und Domaenenkammer - Akten
classification_path: Wasserbauregistratur >> Netzebruch-Melioration >> Vermessungs- und Grenz-Sachen, Besitzbestaetigung und Besitzwechsel von Bruchgrundstuecken
locality: marshland west of the Drage border river, belonging to Amt Driesen [Drezdenko]
affected_extent_km: one Bruch parcel on the Prussian bank
why: A standing Polish magnate's claim on marshland on the Prussian side of the Drage, not an effected boundary change. A claim asserted is not a line moved, so it lowers confidence in the detail of this frontier without changing its position.
